translation.name: Gu ñio'ki'ñ gu Dios na bhaan tu a'ga guch xoi'kam

book.name: NAT JAX TƗ TƗƗ GU JUAN
book.commonName: NAT JAX TƗ TƗƗ GU JUAN
book.title: NAT JAX TƗ TƗƗ GU JUAN

content: Gu gook tujuandam tugiꞌñ gu Dios

Baꞌ mɨkkat maaꞌn xiñ maa mɨt gu jupaabdakar jaꞌp tuꞌm na tootkom, miꞌ dhɨr baꞌp jiñ chɨtda am: ―Jupaabdaꞌ ap dhiꞌ kɨꞌn gu chiopgaꞌn gu Dios gio gu sasoiꞌ mɨmɨiꞌñkar na bhaan tum makgɨrxiꞌñ gu Dios, gio baꞌ nap ja jaꞌkɨlhdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam nam jɨꞌk aix nam mi chu daan ɨrban dɨr.

Dai mu jaꞌp dɨɨrap dɨr gu chiop jap cham jupaabaꞌndaꞌ, na guꞌ dhiꞌ miꞌ dhɨr jaꞌp ja aꞌm bipioꞌ guiꞌ nam cham tɨ jɨɨgiꞌñ aañ jiñ bui. Na guꞌ dhiꞌ jaꞌp jir jum duukam nam bɨɨx tuꞌ pɨx ja ɨlhdhaꞌ guiꞌ nam jɨꞌk ba tɨ jɨɨgiꞌñdhaꞌ aañ jiñ bui baik oidhaꞌ daman taak juugɨt.

Baꞌ aañ gook mu ja jootsaꞌ guñ chujuandam tuk nam jiñ aꞌmkam tu ja aꞌgidhaꞌ guñ ñiꞌook bɨɨx gu jaꞌtkam baik oidhaꞌ daman taak juugɨt. Gampaiꞌ pɨx tuiꞌñgɨdaꞌ am, jix xaasak tɨ tɨiꞌchgɨdaꞌ am na bhaan jix maatɨꞌ kaꞌ nam soiꞌ pɨx jum ɨlhiiꞌñchuꞌndaꞌ.
Guiꞌ jɨꞌ gook tujuandam tugiꞌñ gu Dios, dhiꞌ pɨx puiꞌ jaꞌk jum maaxiꞌñ am gu gook oliibos na jaꞌpni bɨɨpɨꞌ dɨr tuꞌt bhaiꞌ na paiꞌ daa gu Dios, gio gu gook na bhaan jum tuttu gu kañdhiir.

Baꞌ nat paiꞌ dhuuk mu ja joot gu Dios gu gook tujuandam tugiꞌñ nam tu ja aꞌgiꞌñpuꞌ gu jaꞌtkam, cham jɨꞌxdhaꞌ jax ja dooda mɨt gu jaꞌtkam sia kum tɨix ja bhaamkiꞌñ, na guꞌ bɨxchuꞌx bhaiꞌ nam pu tu duñiaꞌ, ja chiichiñ am dɨr busaak gu tai. Baꞌ jaiꞌ dhɨt nam tɨix ja koodam, pu ja mɨiꞌñ jamɨt.

Siax bhaiꞌ na mɨt puiꞌ tu duu nat cham duuꞌn baik oidhaꞌ daman taak na mɨt jɨꞌx juugɨt tu ja aꞌgi gu jaꞌtkam gu ñioꞌkiꞌñ gu Dios na jax jaꞌk tu duñiaꞌ gatuuk, gio na mɨt ɨꞌɨɨr jup duu gu suudaiꞌ, gio baꞌ na mɨt puiꞌ jaꞌk tu duu nam bɨxchuꞌ bhaan bhaiꞌ jim tulhiiñaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na mɨt jɨꞌx juugɨt ɨlh.

Guꞌ baꞌ nat paiꞌ dhuuk jum ai na jɨꞌx juugɨt daaxix nam tu aꞌgaꞌ, na mɨt bɨɨx kap ba tɨɨmo nam tu aꞌgimɨk gu Dios ñioꞌkiꞌñ, maaꞌn gu nobiiꞌñ gu jaꞌook nax ɨɨbhidham tuꞌm mɨjɨ dɨr buusnɨk na paiꞌ gɇꞌ tɨ dɨꞌ bhaiꞌ ji chu kokda ja bui, ja maiꞌchɨk pu ja koi.

Miꞌ pɨx jaꞌp bɨɨt am baꞌbhak sanoop, miꞌ ɨrban gu gɇꞌ kiicham na Jerusaleen tɨ tɨɨꞌ, na mɨt paiꞌ gɨbiimɨk sissapa ɨp kuruus taꞌm guch Xoiꞌkam janoꞌ na mu xi oilhimɨk, miꞌ na paiꞌ jaꞌp ji buusan na gook kɨꞌn tɨ tɨɨꞌ: Sodooma gio baꞌ Ejipto, nam guꞌ puiꞌ jaꞌk jup tu jim gu miꞌ oiꞌñkam Jerusaleen na jax gu Sodooma kam gio gu Ejipto kam.

Baik tanoolh daman taak miꞌ pu bɨɨt gu ja tutkuꞌ gu gook tujuandam tugiꞌñ gu Dios. Bɨɨx na jɨꞌk jaꞌtkam ja tɨɨ mɨt nam miꞌ pɨx jaꞌp koꞌiix, sia guiꞌ nam mɨk jaꞌk oiꞌdhaꞌ, gio jaiꞌ guiꞌ nam maakam tu ñiok. Bɨɨx kap dɨr na jɨꞌx oiꞌñgaꞌn ja tɨɨ mɨt, baꞌ pu cham jaroiꞌm guguux na ja yaaspaꞌ, miꞌ pɨx xi ja nɨiꞌñ am, nam guꞌ tuꞌ pɨx ja ɨlhiiꞌñ.

Dai na mɨt joidham jix bhaiꞌ bhaiꞌ jim ɨlh bɨɨx na jɨꞌk jaꞌtkam na mɨt ba ja tɨɨ na mɨt ba koi guiꞌ jɨꞌ gook tujuandam tugiꞌñ gu Dios, pɨx am tum aꞌonbagiꞌñ am bɨɨx jɨꞌmaꞌn gux dhaꞌram namkɨm, nam guꞌ puiꞌ xim aaꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jaꞌp jaꞌk joidham jix bhaiꞌ ba tu ja jimiaꞌ, cham tuꞌ bhaan kam tulhiiñaꞌ am, na mɨt guꞌ ba koi guiꞌ nam puiꞌ jaꞌk ka tu buaꞌt.

Baꞌ miꞌ dhɨr nat xim ai gu baik tanoolh daman taak, gu Dios giop ba ja duduaꞌñ gu gook tujuandam tugiꞌñ, ba baapam jamɨt miꞌ dhɨr nam paiꞌ ka bɨɨtɨt. Baꞌ giilhim bhaiꞌ ji chootoꞌn jamɨt bɨɨx na jɨꞌk jaꞌtkam na mɨt ba ja tɨɨ gu gook jaꞌtkam na mɨt giop ba dudua nam ka koꞌiix kat.

Jaꞌxpɨx bhammɨx dhaam dɨr muiꞌ ba tum ñio gɇꞌ kɨꞌn, jup ja tɨtda am gu gook tujuandam tugiꞌñ gu Dios: ―Bhaiꞌ gor bi jiim. Baꞌ gu gook tujuandam gamaiꞌp ji chɨɨtɨs jamɨt joidham tɨbaaꞌñ chaꞌm na mɨt ba jii bhammɨ jaꞌk jix dhaam buiñor gu Dios ja nɨiꞌñchudat bɨɨx gu jaꞌtkam nam jix ja bhaamkiꞌñ.

Baꞌ miꞌ dhɨr jix ioꞌm bhaiꞌ ji giꞌndokɨ gu oiꞌñgaꞌn na mɨt jax pɨx bhammɨ ji bhiibhiꞌñ gu gook tujuandam tugiꞌñ gu Dios, baꞌ jɨꞌkchi iaꞌrɨ gu baꞌbhak na jɨꞌk daaxix na iaꞌlhiaꞌ guiꞌ gu tanoolh, gio gu jaꞌtkam xijum gook miil jup koi mɨt nat ja tɨim gu baꞌbhak. Baꞌ guiꞌ na mɨt jɨꞌk bii, jix chotdonɨk ma tu daanɨ mɨt buiñor gu Dios nax dhaam jup tuꞌiiꞌ.
Gook moo ba jim gu tulhiiñaraꞌ, maaꞌn pɨx ba bii na puiꞌ tum kuugalhdhaꞌ.
Na jumaip ba tu kuichdhaꞌ gu nobiiꞌñ gu Dios nam baꞌ kɨꞌn bar daipuꞌ kaꞌ
Baꞌ nat paiꞌ dhuuk jumaip xi chu kuich gu nobiiꞌñ gu Dios nam baꞌ kɨꞌn bar daipuꞌ kaꞌ, muiꞌ dhɨt bhaiꞌ ji chum ñio gɇꞌ kɨꞌn bhammɨ dɨr jix dhaam, jup kaiꞌch am:

content.text: Dhi Dios jich Gɨꞌkoraꞌ bɨɨmaꞌn guch Xoiꞌkam,
bɨɨx kap bar gɇꞌgɇrkam am na jɨꞌx oiꞌñgaꞌn,
baꞌ gammɨjɨ pu bar gɇꞌgɇrkam kaꞌ am sia nar paiꞌ dhuuk kaꞌ gɨt.

content: Baꞌ gu maaꞌn ooꞌm daman maakob gu jaꞌtkam nam jir jagɨꞌgɨr paꞌ, nam bɨɨx xikoolh dhɨr daraa miꞌ na paiꞌ daa gu Dios, na mɨt jax ja oꞌlhia kɨꞌn guguu, naiꞌ ji mumgia mɨt, dɨɨrap xi chu sissap gu ja moom, bhaiꞌ ji chu daanɨ mɨt buiñor,
jup kaiꞌch am:

content.text: Taxchaab Dios jich Gɨꞌkoraꞌ nap jix ioꞌm jir gɇꞌkam kat bɨxchuꞌx aichuꞌn nap pu tu duñiaꞌ,
gio nap bɨjɨk dɨr pux jaiꞌch na chakui jaiꞌch kat dhi oiꞌñgaꞌn,
nap guꞌ aap bɨɨx kap bar gɇꞌkam baꞌ xib na jɨꞌx oiꞌñgaꞌn gam sia nar pa jaꞌk.
Muiꞌ jaiꞌ dhɨt gu jaꞌtkam na jɨꞌx oiꞌñgaꞌn nam cham tɨ jɨɨgiꞌñ aap jum bui,
tɨix bhaak am nap bɨɨx kap bar gɇꞌkam na jɨꞌx oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Ku baꞌ guꞌ nap guꞌ ba ja tulhiiñchudaꞌ,
yaꞌ bar bhaan guꞌ nap paiꞌ dhuuk ja aagiꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx na jɨꞌk jaꞌtkam nam tuꞌ jax buimɨk nam duduakat ja tutkuꞌ bhaan,
noꞌm jix kɨɨꞌp jum duukam jup tu buimɨk piam ku guꞌx buam jum duukam.
Xib jap baꞌ ampɨx tu ja makiaꞌ guiꞌ na tuꞌ ja aꞌm bipioꞌ guiꞌ nam bɨjɨk jum aꞌmkam tu aꞌgimɨk gum ñiꞌook,
gio guiꞌ nam jum aꞌmkam tu juanaimɨk,
gam guiꞌ na mɨt tɨ jɨɨꞌñdhak miꞌ puiꞌ jii nap jax jix aaꞌ.
Gio guiꞌ na mɨt jɨꞌk cham tuꞌ kaꞌm jum tɨɨ,
puiꞌp jup ja makiaꞌ na tuꞌ ja aꞌm jup bipioꞌ,
siam chi moor jix chutumñigam piam siam cham tuꞌ biaꞌ.
Sia ja makiaꞌ ap na tuꞌ ja aꞌm bipioꞌ guiꞌ nam tu koꞌktulhdhimɨk bɨɨx kap na jɨꞌx oiꞌñgaꞌn.

content: Baꞌ jaꞌxpɨx bhaiꞌ jim kupioꞌ gu kiꞌñgob bhaiꞌ na paiꞌ tu chiopiꞌ gu Dios. Baꞌ nañ muiꞌ xi chɨ nɨiꞌñ, bhɨjɨmmɨ pɨx daa ɨrban dɨr gux xidhuu kam kaaja. Baꞌ miꞌ dhɨr gɇꞌ bhaiꞌ ji chɨm tɨr, gio nat bhaiꞌ ji giꞌndokɨ gu oiꞌñgaꞌn, gam nat bhaiꞌ ji iiꞌ gu chia.
